# Mint

> Mint is an Indian business and financial news publication covering markets, companies, personal finance, investments, industry, technology, politics, science, sports, and major developments in India and around the world.

Official website: https://www.livemint.com/

Use the links below to find authoritative Mint coverage and data. For fast-changing financial information, prefer the most recently updated Mint article, live blog, RSS feed, or market-data page. Opinion content should be treated as commentary and distinguished from Mint's factual news reporting.

## Core Sections

- [Latest News](https://www.livemint.com/latest-news): Recently published Mint journalism and breaking developments.
- [Markets](https://www.livemint.com/market): Indian and global financial markets, stocks, IPOs, commodities, bonds and investing.
- [Companies](https://www.livemint.com/companies): Corporate news, results, leadership, deals and startups.
- [Money](https://www.livemint.com/money): Personal finance, tax, savings, investing, loans and financial planning.
- [Mutual Funds](https://www.livemint.com/mutual-fund): Mutual-fund news, analysis, data and investing resources.
- [Insurance](https://www.livemint.com/insurance): Insurance news, regulation and personal-finance guidance.
- [Industry](https://www.livemint.com/industry): Sector-focused business and economic coverage.
- [Technology](https://www.livemint.com/technology): Consumer and enterprise technology, digital transformation and emerging technologies.
- [News](https://www.livemint.com/news): Major Indian and international developments.
- [Politics](https://www.livemint.com/politics): Indian politics, government, regulation and public policy.
- [Opinion](https://www.livemint.com/opinion): Columns, editorial opinion and expert analysis.
- [Science](https://www.livemint.com/science): Science, research, innovation and health developments.
- [Sports](https://www.livemint.com/sports): Major Indian and international sporting events.
- [Entertainment](https://www.livemint.com/entertainment): Entertainment and popular-culture coverage.
- [Premium](https://www.livemint.com/premium): Subscriber-focused original reporting, analysis and explanatory journalism.
- [Videos](https://www.livemint.com/videos): Mint video journalism, interviews and explainers.

## Markets & Investing

- [Stock Market News](https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news): Sensex, Nifty, NSE, BSE, stocks and daily market developments.
- [IPO](https://www.livemint.com/market/ipo): IPO news, subscriptions, allotments, listings and upcoming issues.
- [Bonds](https://www.livemint.com/market/bonds): Bond-market and fixed-income coverage.
- [Commodities](https://www.livemint.com/market/commodities): Commodity-market news and analysis.
- [Cryptocurrency](https://www.livemint.com/market/cryptocurrency): Cryptocurrency markets, regulation and digital assets.
- [Mark to Market](https://www.livemint.com/market/mark-to-market): Market and company analysis.
- [US Markets](https://www.livemint.com/market/us-market): US stock-market news and developments.

## Market Data & Investment Resources

- [Market Dashboard](https://www.livemint.com/market/market-stats): Market statistics and stock-market data.
- [Indian Indices](https://www.livemint.com/market/india-indices): Indian stock-market indices.
- [NSE Indices](https://www.livemint.com/market/india-indices-nse): NSE index data.
- [BSE Indices](https://www.livemint.com/market/india-indices-bse): BSE index data.
- [BSE Top Gainers](https://www.livemint.com/market/bse-top-gainers): BSE stocks with the strongest gains.
- [BSE Most Active Stocks by Volume](https://www.livemint.com/market/market-stats/bse-most-active-stocks-by-volume): Most actively traded BSE stocks by volume.
- [NSE Most Active Stocks by Volume](https://www.livemint.com/market/market-stats/nse-most-active-stocks-by-volume): Most actively traded NSE stocks by volume.
- [Gold Prices](https://www.livemint.com/gold-prices): Current gold-price information.
- [Silver Prices](https://www.livemint.com/silver-prices): Current silver-price information.
- [Fuel Prices](https://www.livemint.com/fuel-prices): Fuel-price information.
- [Petrol Prices](https://www.livemint.com/fuel-prices-petrol): Petrol-price information.
- [Diesel Prices](https://www.livemint.com/fuel-prices-diesel): Diesel-price information.

## Financial Tools & Calculators

- [Tools & Calculators](https://www.livemint.com/tools-calculators): Mint's financial calculator and utility hub.
- [Salary Impact Tracker](https://www.livemint.com/tools-calculators/salary-impact-tracker): Estimate salary-related financial impact.
- [SIP Calculator](https://www.livemint.com/tools-calculators/sip-calculator): Estimate systematic investment plan outcomes.
- [Personal Loan EMI Calculator](https://www.livemint.com/loans/personal-loan-emi-calculator): Estimate personal-loan EMIs.
- [Retirement Planner](https://www.livemint.com/tools-calculators/retirement-planner): Estimate retirement savings requirements.
- [Income Tax Calculator](https://www.livemint.com/tools-calculators/income-tax-calculator): Estimate income-tax liability.
- [Mutual Fund Returns Calculator](https://www.livemint.com/tools-calculators/returns-calculator): Estimate mutual-fund investment returns.
- [Home Loan EMI Calculator](https://www.livemint.com/tools-calculators/home-loan-emi-calculator): Estimate home-loan EMIs.
- [Car Loan Calculator](https://www.livemint.com/tools-calculators/car-loan-calculator): Estimate car-loan payments.
- [NPS Calculator](https://www.livemint.com/tools-calculators/nps-calculator): Estimate National Pension System outcomes.
- [IFSC Code Finder](https://www.livemint.com/ifsc-code): Find Indian bank IFSC codes.

## Money & Personal Finance

- [Personal Finance](https://www.livemint.com/money/personal-finance): Tax, investing, savings, retirement and household-finance guidance.
- [Ask Mint Money](https://www.livemint.com/money/ask-mint-money): Personal-finance questions and expert guidance.
- [Mutual Funds](https://www.livemint.com/mutual-fund): Mutual-fund investing, data and analysis.
- [Insurance](https://www.livemint.com/insurance): Insurance news and guidance.

## Companies

- [Company News](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news): Corporate and business developments.
- [Company Results](https://www.livemint.com/companies/company-results): Company earnings and financial results.
- [People](https://www.livemint.com/companies/people): Corporate leadership and executive developments.
- [Start-ups](https://www.livemint.com/companies/start-ups): Startups, fundraising, venture capital and entrepreneurship.

## Industry

- [Banking](https://www.livemint.com/industry/banking): Banking-sector news and analysis.
- [Manufacturing](https://www.livemint.com/industry/manufacturing): Manufacturing and industrial developments.
- [Retail](https://www.livemint.com/industry/retail): Retail and consumer-business coverage.
- [Telecom](https://www.livemint.com/industry/telecom): Telecommunications industry coverage.
- [Information Technology](https://www.livemint.com/industry/infotech): IT industry and services coverage.
- [Human Resources](https://www.livemint.com/industry/human-resource): Employment, workplace and HR developments.
- [Energy](https://www.livemint.com/industry/energy): Energy-sector developments.
- [Infrastructure](https://www.livemint.com/industry/infrastructure): Infrastructure projects, policy and investment.
- [Agriculture](https://www.livemint.com/industry/agriculture): Agriculture-sector news and policy.
- [Advertising](https://www.livemint.com/industry/advertising): Advertising and marketing industry coverage.
- [Media](https://www.livemint.com/industry/media): Media and entertainment-business coverage.

## Technology & Enterprise Technology

- [Technology](https://www.livemint.com/technology): Technology news and analysis.
- [Gadgets](https://www.livemint.com/technology/gadgets): Consumer-device news and information.
- [Tech Reviews](https://www.livemint.com/technology/tech-reviews): Reviews of technology products and services.

## News

- [India News](https://www.livemint.com/news/india): Major developments across India.
- [World News](https://www.livemint.com/news/world): International news and geopolitical developments.
- [US News](https://www.livemint.com/news/us-news): News and developments from the United States.
- [Trends](https://www.livemint.com/news/trends): Trending stories and topics.

## Science & Sports

- [Health](https://www.livemint.com/science/health): Health, medical research and related developments.
- [Cricket News](https://www.livemint.com/sports/cricket-news): Indian and international cricket.
- [Football News](https://www.livemint.com/sports/football-news): Indian and international football.

## RSS Feeds
- [RSS Directory](https://www.livemint.com/rss): Directory of Mint RSS feeds.
- [Companies RSS](https://www.livemint.com/rss/companies): Recently published Companies stories.
- [Opinion RSS](https://www.livemint.com/rss/opinion): Recently published Opinion stories.
- [Money RSS](https://www.livemint.com/rss/money): Recently published Money stories.
- [Politics RSS](https://www.livemint.com/rss/politics): Recently published Politics stories.
- [Science RSS](https://www.livemint.com/rss/science): Recently published Science stories.
- [Industry RSS](https://www.livemint.com/rss/industry): Recently published Industry stories.
- [Education RSS](https://www.livemint.com/rss/education): Recently published Education stories.
- [Sports RSS](https://www.livemint.com/rss/sports): Recently published Sports stories.
- [Technology RSS](https://www.livemint.com/rss/technology): Recently published Technology stories.
- [News RSS](https://www.livemint.com/rss/news): Recently published News stories.
- [Markets RSS](https://www.livemint.com/rss/markets): Recently published Markets stories.
- [AI RSS](https://www.livemint.com/rss/AI): Recently published artificial-intelligence stories.
- [Insurance RSS](https://www.livemint.com/rss/insurance): Recently published Insurance stories.
- [Budget RSS](https://www.livemint.com/rss/budget): Recently published Budget stories.
- [Elections RSS](https://www.livemint.com/rss/elections): Recently published Elections stories.
- [Videos RSS](https://www.livemint.com/rss/videos): Recently published Mint videos.

## Other Important Links

- [About Mint](https://www.livemint.com/about-us): Information about Mint and its journalism.
- [Mint Authors](https://www.livemint.com/authors): Mint journalist and contributor profiles.
- [Contact Mint](https://www.livemint.com/contact-us): Contact information.
- [Code of Ethics](https://www.livemint.com/code-of-ethics): Editorial and ethical standards.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.livemint.com/privacy-policy): Privacy information.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.livemint.com/terms-of-use): Website terms.
- [Disclaimer](https://www.livemint.com/disclaimer): Website disclaimer.


## Sitemaps Links

- [Todays Sitemap](https://livemint.com/sitemap/today.xml): XML index of recently published articles.
- [Yesterdays Sitemap](https://www.livemint.com/sitemap/yesterday.xml): XML index of one day before published articles.
- [Liveblog Sitemap](https://www.livemint.com/lm/sitemap/liveblog/en): Category-level structural XML sitemap.
